brief:
Currency markets in Palestine recorded a notable decline Friday morning as the dollar fell to 2.96 shekels per unit, Shehab Wire reported. The drop marked a significant pullback from the stronger levels the U.S. currency had commanded in recent trading sessions.

The dinar traded at 4.18 shekels, while the euro was quoted at 3.42 shekels. The broader currency movements reflected shifting dynamics in Palestinian foreign exchange markets as traders adjusted positions ahead of the weekend.
